note: Both sets correctly capture the CCD282 EMCCD, 163 K operating temperature, 8k×4k format, 4k×4k center imaging area, and 1.0 µm response. Set B additionally captures the broadband "astro" coating, which Set A omits entirely, while Set A repeats the 4k×4k center imaging area fact twice. Set B's only flaw is lumping delta doping under "substrate modification", a mild misbinding since delta doping is a detector modification rather than a substrate one. Overall B covers the sensor description more completely with less redundancy.
remarks: Both sets ignore the thruster-firing readout condition (read out as fast as possible to keep photon count below full well) and the frame-store/readout architecture; that operational fact is missed by both. Set A's two 4k×4k claims are the same fact under two attribute names.
